press_references.value: Realta Fusion & Madison Gas and Electric Announce Strategic Partnership to Explore 200-MWe Fusion Energy Power Plant in Wisconsin

partnership_announcements.description: Realta Fusion, Madison Gas and Electric, and parent MGE Energy announced a strategic partnership to evaluate the joint development of a 200-MWe fusion power plant in Wisconsin. MGE will also provide equipment, engineering, technical, siting, permitting, interconnection, and financing support.

press_references.value: REALTA FUSION SELECTS WISCONSIN FOR FUSION ENERGY R&D FACILITY

partnership_announcements.description: Realta Fusion formed a new partnership with the state of Wisconsin and the city of Madison, supported by up to $55 million in tax incentives and TIF financing, to establish its headquarters and fusion R&D facility at the former Oscar Mayer plant in Madison.

press_references.value: Realta Fusion and Kyoto Fusioneering Forge Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Global Fusion Energy Commercialization

partnership_announcements.description: Realta Fusion and Kyoto Fusioneering entered a bilateral strategic partnership to co-develop plasma heating systems for magnetic mirror fusion machines, explore mirror-based neutron sources, and coordinate cross-border fusion supply chains between the U.S. and Japan.

overview_description.description: Realta Fusion develops fusion energy technology for the production of industrial heat and power. It applies advances in super-conducting materials, plasma physics, and computing power to a simple linear fusion reactor configuration. It utilizes abundant fuel sources to provide a zero-carbon source of heat and power.
